base: R8 build67012; both raw physical runs retained

physicalEvidence.diagnosis: Both top holds have nearly-zero mean position error with about0.11-0.12mm skew. Frozen command-space mapping shows retained Y NN partly cancels one side of alpha correction. This is an implementation hypothesis, not a proven sole cause or measured-force inference.

singleMechanism: On symmetric limits only, beta=min(1,(2*abs(mean position error)+50um)/abs(left-right position error)), with beta1 near zero skew. Scale Y NN request AND Y gradient/repair learning ceiling. Preserve alpha request, both separate work bounds, old allocator/current/slew/speed/position/fault/timing guards. Do not grow Y nodes on beta<1 cycles.
unchanged: No original BASE gains, hard current limits, NN300count limit, normal2count/ms slew, speed taper/brake, CAN/BMS guards, motion reference, anti-windup, UART cadence or ordinary comparator changes. No online tuning or automatic flashing.
telemetry: 107channels/40ms/115200 JustFloat. Live I92 and EVENTv39 now beta. I17/18 actual learning; I25=4 means R9 Y attenuation, NOT old R3 mode4. Existing repair/retention modes retain meanings. Post-stop I88=4431,I89=4 identifies completed replay.
trial: At most one exploratory empty-load2mm/1200-1200 manual-flash run after compiled/host release checks. Keep power/temperature conditions documented and comparable. No repeat batch authorized by this protocol.
exploratoryComparison: Same phase2-5 mean-position tracking and left-right synchronization metrics; exact common elapsed timestamps without interpolation. Compare BOTH R8 records and fixed BLNN; no best-run selection or favorable-window replacement. Desired signal is lower sync RMS than R8 without increased tracking beyond its observed range; this is a screening goal, not a statistical noninferiority claim. Ordinary BLNN remains the independent performance comparator.
export: On success phase6/fault0, wait for I88=4431,I89=4 then retain5seconds; normally absoluteI0>=100s. Abnormal motion or fault: stop safely, keep same history and preserve fault replay; no automatic retry.
limitations: Assumed model not identified/calibrated to hardware; 36case checks are regression evidence only. No new physical result, hardware timing qualification or closed-loop stability/superiority proof. This exploratory candidate changes the coordination mechanism, not the archived original experiments or declared paper claims.
